plugins.readme_text: # dsh-oi-senior v1.0.8 —— 信奥学长 DSH 插件 把技能包 **oi-senior（信奥学长）** 落地成 DeepSeek Harness 插件：面向 GESP 1~8 级、CSP-J/S、NOIP、NOI 学习者的**算法竞赛陪练学长**。 学长的定位是「陪你刷、给参考实现」：独立推导、一次给三版 C++14 代码（常规注释 / 详细讲解 / 极简可提交）、附一份解题说明，并用**本机 g++ 真编译真评测**，做题记录归档到 ima 笔记本「**信奥学长-题解复盘**」。 > 与「信奥教练 oi-coach」的分工：oi-coach 是苏格拉底式教练，逼你自己想、默认不给答案；本插件是给你对照实现的学长。两者评测与归档逻辑一致，可并行使用。 > **使用者请先看 [USER-GUIDE.md](USER-GUIDE.md)**（安装、四种用法、评测与归档说明、常见问题）；本文档偏实现与维护。 > > 对外介绍/推荐给同学家长可发这篇公众号文章：《「信奥学长」刷题好搭档上线 WorkBuddy：题意拆解、考点梳理、解题思路、易错点、三版代码、真评测带归档》 > > 另有 3 篇配套说明（学习路线 / 教练介绍 / 错题讲解实战），按场景挑一条发，见下文「参考阅读」。 --- ## 提供的工具 | 工具 | 作用 | 何时使用 | | --- | --- | --- | | `oi_solve` | 接题工作台：返回学长规程（角色称呼、独立推导纪律、三版代码规范、解题说明骨架、改代码模式、归档格式、随包资源路径） | 用户以「学长 / 信奥学长 / oi学长 / oi-senior」开头，或贴出题面 / 题号 / 洛谷链接 / 自己的半成品代码 | | `oi_judge` | **真编译真评测**：`g++ -std=c++14 -O2 -Wall` 编译后逐点判定 AC / WA / TLE / RE / CE，回填每点耗时、期望与实际输出 | 批改提交、验证参考实现、改代码模式下的真编译 | | `oi_archive` | 按技能 Step 4 的 10 字段与 6 条格式细则生成归档 markdown，并写入 ima 笔记本「信奥学长-题解复盘」 | 一道题讲完后归档题解复盘 | | `oi_doctor` | 环境自检：ima 调用器、凭证来源、目标笔记本 folder_id、本机 g++ 是否可用 | 排查「归档为什么没生效 / 能不能真评测」 | ### 为什么要有 `oi_solve` 技能规程（三版代码、10 字段归档格式、评测边界、称呼规则）如果只写在 SKILL.md 里，会随上下文被压缩掉。`oi_solve` 把这些**机器可读地**固化成一次工具调用，保证每一轮回复都守得住规程——尤其是容易漂移的三条： - 自称「学长」、称用户「学弟 / 学妹」，**绝不把用户叫成「学长」**； - 三版代码只改注释不改逻辑，且 v3 必须提醒「先自己写自己交」； - 评测必须写明测试点来源，**不得暗示跑了 OJ 私密测试点**。 --- ## 目录结构 ``` dsh-oi-senior/ ├── src/ │ ├── index.ts # 插件入口：name/inject/apply/Config + 注册 4 个工具 │ ├── judge.ts # C++14 评测引擎（纯 Node 内置模块，无框架依赖） │ ├── ima.ts # ima 归档引擎（纯 Node 内置模块，无框架依赖） │ └── qrcodes.ts # 关注二维码资源清单（公众号/视频号/知识库/小程序） ├── assets/qrcodes/ # 四张二维码原图（jpg，随包分发） ├── dist/ # 构建产物（加载时使用） ├── test/ │ ├── judge.test.mjs # 评测引擎测试（本机有 g++ 时含真实编译评测用例） │ ├── ima.test.mjs # 归档引擎测试（本地假调用器，不依赖外网） │ ├── qrcodes.test.mjs # 二维码资源：文件真实存在、签名合法、体积合规 │ └── inline-images.test.mjs # data URL 内嵌与大请求改走直连 HTTP ├── scripts/ │ ├── build.mjs # 构建：src/*.ts -> dist/*.js + 语法校验（+ 可选桩自检） │ ├── verify-real.mjs # 用**真实** @deepseek-ai/* 加载 dist 并调用 apply() │ ├── e2e-archive.mjs # 真实归档链路验证（会真的往 ima 写一条笔记，默认不要跑） │ ├── e2e-qrcode-note.mjs # 真实写入带二维码的笔记（会真的写，用于验证渲染） │ ├── e2e-list-notes.mjs # 只读盘点笔记本（不写） │ ├── verify-prompt-section.mjs # 常驻提示段健壮性（有/抛错/缺失三种 ctx） │ └── install.mjs # 安装到 DSH profile / 卸载（含 YAML 复验） ├── skills/oi-senior/ # 随包技能原件（SKILL.md、templates/、oi_tools/） ├── cordis.patch.yml # bundle 配置层（配合 `dsh plugin add` 使用） └── package.json # bundle manifest（声明 dsh.bundle） ``` > 说明：`src/*.ts` 的文件内容是**合法 ESM JavaScript**（无类型注解）。扩展名沿用 `.ts` 是为了与技能包命名习惯对齐；构建即「拷贝 + 改名」。 --- ## 安装 ### 快速安装（推荐） ```sh cd dsh-oi-senior node scripts/build.mjs # 构建 dist/ node scripts/install.mjs # 安装到 desktop profile ``` `install.mjs` 做三件事： 1. 在包内 `node_modules/@deepseek-ai` 下为 `dsh-tools`、`schemastery` 建立指向 DSH profile 自身副本的目录链接 —— 这是插件唯一的外部运行期依赖，指向同一份副本可保证版本天然对齐； 2. 在 `~/.dsh/profiles//cordis.patch.yml` 追加一条 `oi-senior` 条目，入口用**绝对 `file:///` URL**，因此插件不必拷贝进 DSH 仓库、也不必成为 pnpm workspace 成员； 3. 落盘后用 profile 自带的 `js-yaml` **复验**：仍是合法顶层数组、`oi-senior` 恰好出现一次、入口文件可达。复验不过就报错，不会给 DSH 留下坏配置层。 > **为什么必须包在 `- insert:` 里**：profile 的 patch 层中，**平铺的 `- id: xxx` 是「覆盖既有节点」**，而「新增一个插件节点」必须写在 `- insert:` 列表下（DSH 各 bundle 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 都是这个形态）。把新插件写成平铺条目不会报错，但会被当成对不存在节点的覆盖而静默失效 —— 这是本项目踩过并已用复验堵住的坑。 常用参数： ```sh node scripts/install.mjs --preview # 只打印改动，不落盘 node scripts/install.mjs --profile web # 指定 profile（默认 desktop） node scripts/install.mjs --uninstall # 移除条目 ``` **装完需要重启 DSH**（或该条目被 HMR 热加载）后 4 个工具才会出现。 ### 作为 bundle 安装（分发路径） ```sh # 在 dsh 仓库根目录执行 pnpm dsh plugin --profile add ./dsh-oi-senior pnpm dsh --profile ``` ### 配置 在 `cordis.patch.yml`（或 bundle 配置层）的 `config` 中调整： ```yaml config: judge: compiler: g++ # 编译器命令 std: '-std=c++14' # 语言标准（技能规定 C++14） optimization: '-O2' timeLimitMs: 2000 # 单点时限（毫秒） compileTimeoutMs: 30000 workDir: '' # 空 = 系统临时目录（评测后自动清理） ima: enabled: true # 关掉则 oi_archive 静默跳过 cliPath: '' # ima_api.cjs 路径；空 = 自动定位 clientId: '' # 空 = 用环境变量 / ~/.config/ima/ apiKey: '' timeoutMs: 20000 ``` --- ## ima 归档的前置条件 `oi_archive` 走的是技能自带的 **`ima_api.cjs` 调用器**形态（与 `oi_tools/archive_note.cjs` 一致）。要真正写入，需要： 1. 已安装腾讯 ima 桌面端并登录； 2. 已安装 **ima-skill**（内含 `ima_api.cjs`）；插件按 `配置 cliPath → 环境变量 IMA_API_CJS → ~/.workbuddy/skills、~/.dsh/skills、~/.claude/skills、~/.codex/skills、~/.cursor/skills、~/.workbuddy/plugins` 的顺序定位； 3. 已在 生成自己的 Client ID / API Key，写入 `~/.config/ima/{client_id,api_key}`； 4. 已在 ima 客户端**手动创建**笔记本「**信奥学长-题解复盘**」（API 无法自动建笔记本）。 任一条件缺失 → 本轮归档**静默跳过**，绝不假装存过、绝不把笔记落到根目录。先用 `oi_doctor` 自检最省事。 ### 归档格式要点（技能 Step 4 + 本项目扩展） - H1 **不含日期时间**，洛谷题格式：`# P7077 [CSP-S 2020] 函数调用 - 树形DP+拓扑序`（题号在最前，题名与主题之间用英文半角 ` - `）； - 正文**最上边的固定版式**（由插件自动写入，模型不需要也不应该自己拼）： ``` # P7077 [CSP-S 2020] 函数调用 - 树形DP+拓扑序 --- 归档人：信奥学长插件 归档时间：2026-10-05 09:47:09 --- ``` 「归档人」是固定署名（`ARCHIVER` 常量，见 `src/ima.ts`）；两条 `---` 分隔线分别夹在「标题与归档人之间」和「归档时间与正文之间」；归档时间精确到秒； - **两行用「普通段落 + 前后空行」**（无项目符号、不加粗），结构与「信奥教练」的笔记一致。实测过的四种写法： | 写法 | 是否加粗 | 项目符号 | 归档时间下方的 `---` | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 普通段落，`---` 后**不留空行** | ❌ 加粗 | 无 | 正常 | | 缩进两格 ` 归档人：…` | ❌ 加粗 | 无 | **被吃掉，不显示** | | 列表项 `- 归档人：…` | ✅ 不加粗 | ❌ 有一个小圆点 | 正常 | | **普通段落 + 前后各留一个空行（当前采用）** | ✅ 不加粗 | ✅ 无 | 正常 | 关键在**空行**：空行把两行各自切成独立段落，ima 就不会把「分隔线 `---` 之后的第一段」当标签行加粗。 - **首部没有「记录时间」**：已按要求去掉，`记录时间` 不再出现； - URL 前后各留一个空格（否则 ima 里点链接会 404）； - 难度写「（蓝题）提高+/省选−」，中文全角括号，且难度值要**从洛谷题目页「难度[xxx]」字段抓取**，禁止凭记忆估； - 章节顺序固定：题目来源 → 题目难度 → 题目大意 → 考点梳理 → 解题思路 → 易错点 → 参考代码 → 复杂度 → **评测结论**（不叫「状态」）→ 关联题目； - **正文末尾自动追加推广小节**（`## 推荐关注`），内容为「想学更多信奥知识，请关注 欣泽编程 公众号、欣泽编程 视频号、欣泽编程-信奥知识大全 知识库、信奥编程算法 小程序。」：渠道清单是 `src/ima.ts` 里的 `PROMO_CHANNELS` 常量，改一处即可；`oi_archive` 传 `promo: false` 可关闭、传 `promoText` 可覆盖文案； - 成功时回复末尾附 `[归档：成功 note_id=...]`；失败 / 无凭证 / 笔记本不存在时**静默**，不打印任何归档标签。 ### 关注二维码（笔记里也能扫码） 四张二维码随包放在 `assets/qrcodes/`（公众号 / 视频号 / ima 知识库 / 小程序），清单见 `src/qrcodes.ts`。 - **归档笔记**：推广小节（`## 推荐关注` + 一句话渠道文案）之后，**直接跟一张二维码合成图**， 没有小节标题、没有图注（与「信奥教练」笔记本的版式一致）。 合成图里四张二维码各 120×120、间隔 60，整张 **660×120**（`assets/qrcodes/combined.png`）， 笔记里以 `` 显示。 > 为什么不放四张独立图：四张原图宽高比不同，即使写死 `width`/`height`，渲染端仍按原比例缩放， > 结果高度参差不齐、看起来偏大（实测过）。合成图正解。 > 附带好处：笔记体积从 ~585KB 降到 ~107KB。 **视频号 / 知识库两张必须裁剪**：这两个原图带顶部标题、底部说明和 App logo， 整体缩进 120 的格子后二维码本体只剩 ~80px，手机扫不出。裁剪时要注意： - **裁剪框必须是正方形**，否则四张渲染出来尺寸不一致（脚本会校验，非正方形直接报错）； - **别裁掉二维码图案本身**：视频号的放射状装饰点与三个定位角、知识库的绿色底与右下角 `ima` 字样， 都属于二维码图案，切边就扫不出； - 只裁掉纯装饰文字（顶部标题、底部「扫一扫二维码…」「扫码订阅ima知识库」）。 裁剪框是人工用网格量出来的（`scripts/qr-grid.py` 叠坐标 + `scripts/qr-crop-preview.py` 并排预览比较）， 不用自动检测——自动检测会被中间那个彩色 logo 吸走，把二维码边缘切掉。 改了四张原图后要重跑 `python scripts/make-qr-composite.py`； 布局常量在 `src/qrcodes.ts`：`QR_CELL = 120`、`QR_GAP = 60`、`COMBINED_WIDTH = 660`、`COMBINED_HEIGHT = 120`。 `oi_archive` 传 `qrcodes: false` 可关闭二维码。 - **对话回复**：`oi_solve` 返回的「关注二维码」小节给出四张图的绝对路径，模型用 `![](绝对路径)` 直接渲染成图片。 **为什么不走 ima 的图片上传接口**：`openapi/mcp_cloud_agent/upload_temp_file` 在当前凭证下返回 `100001 session ID is required`（连 ima-skill 自带的 `note-images.cjs --url` 也一样失败），拿不到 `download_url`。 因此改为**把图片以 data URL 内嵌进笔记正文**（已实测 ima 能正常渲染）。 **由此带来的两个实现约束**： 1. 带 data URL 的正文会把请求体撑到 ~586KB，塞进命令行参数会 `spawn ENAMETOOLONG`， 所以 `callImaAuto` 在请求体超过 16KB 时**自动改走直连 HTTP**（协议与 `ima_api.cjs` 等价）。 2. 每条笔记会因此变大（四张二维码约 +438KB → base64 约 +584KB）。内嵌总量有上限 `MAX_INLINE_IMAGE_BYTES = 4 MiB`，超限的图片会被跳过并保留原引用（不阻断归档）。 ### 推广推荐的插入时机 **对话回复末尾也带推广 + 二维码图**：`oi_solve` 返回 `promo.chatFooter.markdown`（分隔线 + 一句话渠道文案 + 同一张二维码合成图）， 模型把它原样附在回复最后。插件级**常驻提示段**（`systemPrompt.section`，名字 `plugin:dsh-oi-senior`，order 106） 里也内联了这整段，所以即使模型没调用 `oi_solve` 也知道要附。 - 同一轮对话只出现一次，不要改写渠道名、不要自己另拼图片路径； - 例外：用户正在排错调 bug、或只问一个极小的问题时可以省略；其余实质回答（讲题、讲解、评测、复盘）都附在末尾； - 对话里的图片用 `![...](<正斜杠绝对路径>)`，DSH 直接读本地文件渲染；笔记里则内嵌为 data URL。 `oi_solve` 还会返回**四张单图**的路径（`qrcodes.items`），用户想看单个渠道时模型可以逐张贴。 ### 参考阅读（4 篇公众号文章） 常量 `REFERENCE_ARTICLES`（`src/index.ts`）里登记了 4 篇说明文章，每篇带 `title / url / when`： | key

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 原生插件 · 项目便笺 · 工作区便笺、轻量待办、自动保存与草稿插入。
plugins.readme_text:
# 项目便笺 · Project Notes

给每个工作区一张随手写的便笺和一份轻量待办。记需求、报错、临时想法；需要讨论时，一键把文字放进 DSH 输入框。

## 安装与使用

在 DSH「插件 → 添加插件」中填写以下 GitHub 仓库地址（也可使用本地插件目录），启用后按宿主提示重新加载。需要 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2 或更新的 0.2.x**。

```text
https://github.com/yxue301603/dsh-project-notes
```

整套安装、迁移和升级步骤见[工具箱安装指南](https://github.com/yxue301603/dsh-everyday-plugins/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md)。

输入框旁点击「项目便笺」，顶端显示当前工作区路径。同一路径下的会话共享记录；不同工作区相互隔离。没有工作区时使用「通用便笺」。Windows 路径大小写和结尾斜杠会归一化。

- **便笺**：直接编辑，自动保存在本机；支持复制、插入整篇或选中文字。插入保留原光标选区文字，不自动发送。
- **待办**：回车添加、勾选完成、编辑内容；按未完成/已完成/全部筛选，显示完成进度。删除后可撤销最近一条。
- **带入对话**：单条待办可插入当前草稿，再由你确认发送。文字使用官方输入接口，保留原有附件和引用。
- **导出**：将当前便笺和待办导出为 Markdown，未保存的编辑也会包含在导出中。
- 清空当前便笺、批量清理已完成和删除旧工作区记录都需要再次确认。

## 数据与边界

只在当前 DSH 来源的浏览器本地存储保存文字及勾选状态；不调用模型、不读取密钥、不扫描项目文件、不向外发送数据。工作区路径仅用于分组。便笺不会因重命名项目或移动目录自动搬迁；可先导出，再在新工作区粘贴内容。

每个项目便笺最多 48,000 个字符、150 条待办，每条 2,000 个字符；最多 60 个工作区、总计约 800,000 个字符。达到上限时提示整理旧内容，不自动删除你的便笺。文字跨浏览器、DSH 来源和机器不会自动同步。

存储失败时显示错误并保留当前便笺的内存文本，可重试、复制或导出；退出 DSH 会丢失尚未保存的内存编辑。损坏数据不会静默重置。清除 DSH 站点数据会移除插件数据。界面支持中文、英文、深色与浅色主题。

See [English documentation](README.en.md).

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 原生插件 · 回答收藏 · 保存回答与摘录，按标签检索，复制或插入草稿。
plugins.readme_text:
# 回答收藏与摘录

为 DeepSeek Harness 添加一个本地个人资料库：收藏好用的回答、命令和片段，再次需要时快速找到并插入草稿。

## 日常使用

- 点击回答下方的 `☆` 收藏全文；先选中此回答中的文字再点 `☆`，只收藏所选内容。
- 从输入框旁的「回答收藏」打开资料库，也可展开「从当前会话收藏」选择已加载的回答。
- 按内容、标题、标签搜索，编辑标题和摘录，使用逗号添加多个标签。
- 复制内容，或安全插入当前草稿。插件不会自动发送，也不会覆盖打开面板后变化的草稿。
- 「原会话」返回收藏的来源会话，并尝试定位原生消息所在位置；原文未加载或界面发生变化时，可在原会话中查找。删除收藏前需要在面板内确认。

收藏保存在当前浏览器或桌面客户端的本地存储，不会同步到其他设备。最多 1,000 条，单条最多 200,000 个字符，总量受浏览器存储限制。清理应用数据会清除收藏。没有 API Key 或模型调用，不向外部服务上传收藏；加载来源消息使用当前 DSH 宿主的原生历史接口。

支持中文、英文以及 DSH 深色和浅色主题。使用原生回答事件和回答动作扩展点，不扫描页面文字。选文通过原生消息身份核对来源，避免把另一条回答的选区记到当前回答名下。

## 安装

在 DSH 的「插件 → 添加插件」中粘贴：

```text
https://github.com/yxue301603/dsh-answer-library
```

安装并启用后，按 DSH 提示重新加载。仓库已包含预构建文件，无需自行编译。需要 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 或兼容的 0.2.x 版本**。迁移、整套安装与升级说明见[工具箱安装指南](https://github.com/yxue301603/dsh-everyday-plugins/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md)。

plugins.description: Auto-recovery for DeepSeek Harness: continues turns that ended abnormally or were swallowed into plain text, and revives stalled model requests.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-unstuck

给 DeepSeek Harness 用的**监督员**插件。dsh 跑着跑着自己断了、卡住了、闷头不动了，它负责发现并把你解开（`unstuck`），不需要你手动发消息。

> **English** — A watchdog plugin for DeepSeek Harness. When a run stops on its own and waits for you to say something, this continues it.
>
> It handles three cases, and nothing else:
> - **Abnormal turn end** (`error`, `aborted` not caused by you, `max-tokens`, `interrupted`) — sends one "continue" after a short delay.
> - **Swallowed turns** — the turn is logged as `completed` even though the model meant to call a tool and an OpenAI-compatible relay emitted the call markup as plain text instead, leaving the agent silently idle. Detected structurally (the reasoning block and the text block are byte-identical, or the text is empty while reasoning is not, or the tail is a broken call tag) and continued with a pointed message asking for the tool call again.
> - **Stalled requests** — a model request was issued and then no stream frame arrived for `stallMs`. The turn is cancelled (`kind: 'hook'`, inbox kept) and continued.
>
> Waiting on an approval or on a question is logged and notified, never answered on your behalf. A stop you pressed yourself, a turn that really finished, and non-retryable errors (auth, quota, context overflow) are all left alone. Detection is pure structure over the session log — no judge model, no network calls.
>
> Install: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Chlyz621/dsh-unstuck` (or run `install.ps1` from a local clone). Config: `<DSH_HOME>/unstuck/config.json`. Log: `<DSH_HOME>/unstuck/unstuck.jsonl`. The detailed documentation below is in Chinese; `PLUGIN-NOTES.md` records why each decision was made.

---

## 它管四件事

| 现象 | 监督员怎么做 |
| --- | --- |
| 一轮对话异常结束（上游报错、输出被截断、进程崩溃留下的残局、非你按的中断） | 等一小会儿，补发一条「继续」 |
| **「假完成」**：日志写着这轮正常结束，其实工具调用被吞了、活没干完（最常见，见下节） | 补一条带指向性的「继续」，让它重新发工具调用 |
| 模型请求发出去了，但很久**没有任何流片段**（假死：TCP 断了但不报错） | 掐掉当前这一轮，再补「继续」 |
| **「问了不等」**：正文问你「你认可吗？」，你没回它，它自己往下开工 | 掐掉这一轮，把发言权还给你（见「问了不等」一节） |
| 卡在等你审批 / 等你回答问题 | 只记录 + 通知，**绝不替你回答** |

不插手的情况：你按了停止、你这轮真的干完了、你正在输入（inbox 里有你的消息）、连续中断超过预算、认证失败这类再试也没用的错误。

「异常结束」具体指这几种 `turn/end` 原因：`error`（上游报错）、`aborted`（不是你按的停止）、`max-tokens`（输出被 token 上限截断）、`interrupted`（进程中断留下的残局）。

---

## 断连根因：中转站把工具调用吞成了正文

这不是猜的，是从真实会话日志里挖出来的。同一会话三轮，**每一轮都是这么断的**：

| turn | 末 step | 耗时 | 块结构 | reasoning 与 text | tool-call | 正文尾部 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 21 | 10.6s | reasoning+text | **逐字节相同** | 无 | `…</｜｜DSML｜｜ calls>` |
| 2 | 138 | 4.5s | reasoning+text | **逐字节相同** | 无 | `…temp dir.</｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter>` |
| 3 | 10 | 18.4s | reasoning+text | **逐字节相同** | 无 | `Hmm, the`（断在词中间） |

同一会话 172 条 assistant 消息里，「reasoning 和 text 逐字节相同且没有 tool-call」只出现这 3 次 —— 正是被吞的 3 次，其余 169 条零误报。

**机理**：模型本来要发工具调用，中转站（`api: openai-completions` 兼容层）没能把 DeepSeek 原生的 `｜｜DSML｜｜` 工具调用标记转成 OpenAI 的 `tool_calls`，那段标记被当普通正文吐了出来。于是 assistant 消息里只剩 reasoning + text、没有 tool-call；agent 循环认为「模型没要求调工具 = 这轮说完了」，`turn/end` 记成 `completed`，agent 静默 idle。

你看到的现象就是「跑着跑着自己断了，得手动发一句才继续」。耗时正常（4.5–18.4s，不是超时）、长度不一（2868–8892 字符，不是 token 上限），所以既不是超时也不是截断，是**协议转换层偶发失败**。

dsh 自带的「继续」按钮也救不了它 —— 那个按钮把 `completed` 当「已收工」，直接拒绝续跑。本插件的 `continueOnSwallowed` 就是专门补这个洞。

### 想根治的话（可选）

根因在中转站那一层，插件只能兜底。能减轻的办法：

- **换模型**：`glm-5.3` / `kimi-k3-1` / `minimax-m3` 这些模型原生就是 OpenAI 风格的工具调用，不走 DSML，理论上不会踩这个坑。改 profile 的 `agent-default-model` 即可。
- **降 `reasoningEffort`**：`max` 会让 reasoning 特别长，长流更容易在中转站出错。降到 `high` 试试。
- **换官方端点**：DeepSeek 官方 API 不会有这层转换。

---

## 问了不等：它问你「你认可吗」，然后自己开工

这是实测抓到的另一种更隐蔽的中断，2026-10-22 02:07 在会话 `session-d54e23f7` 里完整发生了一遍：

| 时刻 | 发生了什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 02:07:24 | assistant 正文写「上面这个 5 表 3 页的范围，**你认可吗？**」，并承诺「认可 → 我下一轮直接出工程骨架」 |
| 02:07:51 | **同一个轮次**里自己开始建工程（`mkdir` → 写 `package.json` → `npm install`） |
| 02:10:10 | 装完 244 个包，后台起好了 |
| 02:10:11 | 你按了停止，然后问「你刚刚都给我提了什么问题？」 |

问题不在「它做错了」，而在**它把「等你点头」和「先干起来」放在了同一个轮次里**：你还没来得及回答，工已经开了一半。等你想改主意，成本已经产生了。

`pauseOnUnansweredQuestion` 就是拦这个：

| 值 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `off` | 不管 |
| `mutate`（默认） | 问完之后只要它开始**动文件**（`write` / `edit` / `delete` / `apply_patch` …）就掐 |
| `any` | 问完之后只要有**任何**下一步动作（含 `bash`）就掐 |

判定用的是结构而不是关键字：正文最后 400 字里出现求确认措辞（「你认可吗」「需要你点头」「请确认」…）或第二人称问句（`你/您 … ？`）。代码围栏里的问号不算 —— 否则它解释这条规则的时候会被自己误伤。

掐掉之后**不会**自动补「继续」，因为该说话的是你。日志里留一条 `question-paused`。

> 只在它真的往下干的时候才掐。只是问一句、然后等你回话，是正常行为。

---

## 三个必须知道的默认行为

1. **只补「继续」两个字。** 它不猜你想干什么，也不改你的需求。续跑消息的来源标记是 `dsh-unstuck`，所以它不会把自己发的消息当成你在说话。
2. **有预算。** 同一个会话连续中断最多自动续跑 `continueMax`（默认 3）次，用完就停手并在日志里记一条 `continue-budget-exhausted`。你只要手动发一条消息，预算立刻清零。
3. **有退避。** 第 1/2/3 次续跑前分别多等 1.5s / 5s / 15s，避免把上游打爆、也避免烧钱。

---

## 安装

两种装法。只想装上用走第一种；要改代码或者离线装走第二种。

### 一、从 GitHub 装（推荐）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile tauri add github:Chlyz621/dsh-unstuck
```

dsh 会把仓库取到 profile 的 `node_modules` 下并登记进 `dsh.profile.bundles`。装完**完全退出** DeepSeek Harness（含托盘图标）再打开。

### 二、从本地目录装（改代码时用）

```powershell
cd <仓库根目录>
pwsh -File .\install.ps1
```

装完**完全退出** DeepSeek Harness（含托盘图标）再打开。

脚本做三件事，每一步都会先备份：

1. 把插件复制到 `<DSH_HOME>\plugins\dsh-unstuck`
2. 在 `<DSH_HOME>\profiles\tauri\package.json` 里登记依赖并加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`
3. 在 profile 的 `node_modules` 下建一个目录联接，让 dsh 能 `require` 到它（不联网、不跑 pnpm）

参数：

```powershell
pwsh -File .\install.ps1 -Profile tauri -DshHome C:\Users\me\.dsh -Force
```

卸载：

```powershell
pwsh -File .\uninstall.ps1          # 只从 profile 摘掉，插件文件留着
pwsh -File .\uninstall.ps1 -Purge  # 连插件文件一起删
```

---

## 怎么确认它活着

```powershell
Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\unstuck\unstuck.jsonl" -Tail 20
```

开机应该有一行 `{"event":"boot",...}`，里面能看到当前生效的配置和挂上了几个监听器。之后每次动手都有记录：

| event | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `boot` / `dispose` | 装上了 / 卸载了 |
| `continue-sent` | 补了一条「继续」（带 attempt、kind、code） |
| `turn-swallowed` | 发现「假完成」（带 why：`dsml-leak` / `echo-reasoning` / `no-output`） |
| `continue-skipped` | 判断过但没补（带 why：`user-abort` / `policy` / `stall-already-handled`） |
| `continue-deferred` | 本来要补，但你在输入或已经跑起来了（`user-took-over` / `inbox-busy`） |
| `continue-budget-exhausted` | 预算用完，需要人看一眼 |
| `stall-detected` | 判定假死（带 silenceMs） |
| `clock-jump` | 机器睡眠/事件循环被卡，这一轮巡检只搬时间锚点、不判定（带 gapMs） |
| `question-paused` | 命中「问了不等」，掐掉了这一轮（带 tools：它本来要动哪些文件） |
| `user-abort-noted` | 你按了停止、且这一轮一个字都没输出（可能就是界面看着卡住） |
| `question-asked` / `approval-asked` | 记录了你被卡住 |
| `question-blocked` / `approval-blocked` | 卡太久，提醒你 |
| `request-retry` | 重试了一次模型请求（默认关闭） |

debug 级的记录（比如每轮一条 `running`）默认不落盘，只有 `verbose: true` 才写，免得把上面这些有用的记录淹掉。

---

## 调参

默认值够用。想改就把示例配置复制过去，改完重启 dsh：

```powershell
Copy-Item .\unstuck.config.example.json "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\unstuck\config.json"
```

优先级：内置默认 < profile 里 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 config < 这个 `config.json`（后者赢）。

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关，关掉后一个监听器都不装 |
| `autoContinue` | `true` | 续跑总开关 |
| `continueMax` | `3` | 每个会话最多自动续几次 |
| `continueText` | `"继续"` | 续跑发什么 |
| `continueOnSwallowed` | `true` | 「假完成」也续跑，见「断连根因」一节 |
| `continueTextSwallowed` | 带指向性的一句 | 「假完成」时发的措辞 |
| `continueOnUserAbort` | `never` | 你按了停止怎么办：`never` 不碰 / `silent` 只在零输出时续 / `always` 一律续 |
| `notifyUserAbort` | `true` | 零输出的用户中断额外提醒一次 |
| `pauseOnUnansweredQuestion` | `mutate` | 「问了不等」拦不拦：`off` / `mutate` / `any`，见上文 |
| `continueDelayMs` | `700` | 发现中断后先等多久 |
| `backoffMs` | `[1500,5000,15000]` | 每次续跑额外等待 |
| `continueOn` | 异常类原因 | 只在这些 turn 结束原因上续跑 |
| `skipCodes` | 认证类错误码 | 命中就不续（试也没用） |
| `autoRetry` | `false` | 模型请求层重试，**默认关**，见下 |
| `retryMax` | `2` | 请求重试次数 |
| `stallEnabled` | `true` | 假死检测开关 |
| `stallMs` | `180000` | 请求发出后多久没流片段算假死（3 分钟） |
| `stallResumeMs` | `800` | 掐掉后等多久再补「继续」 |
| `tickMs` | `15000` | 巡检间隔 |
| `hardStallMs` | `0` | 整轮零事件的兜底阈值，0=关闭（长工具本来就很久没事件） |
| `notifyBlocked` | `true` | 卡审批/等回答时提醒 |
| `blockedNotifyMs` | `120000` | 卡多久开始提醒 |
| `notifyCommand` | `""` | 额外执行的命令，`{msg}` 会替换成正文；留空只写日志 |
| `skipOwnedAgents` | `true` | 子 agent 不插手 |
| `verbose` | `false` | 连 debug 级也打印到控制台 |

### 和 dsh 自带「继续」按钮的关系

桌面端本来就有一个「继续」按钮（`POST /api/tauri/ui/session/resume`），它做的事和本插件一样：判断上一轮是不是正常结束，不是就补一条 `Continue the interrupted task...`。

区别在于**它是手动的**——得你去点。本插件把那套判断搬进进程内、按事件自动触发，而且更保守：

- 你按了停止 → 不续（`continueOnUserAbort` 默认 `never`；想连这种也救就设 `silent`）
- 认证失败 / 余额不足 / 上下文超长 → 不续（点了也没用）
- 连续中断超过 `continueMax` 次 → 停手并提醒
- 你的消息一进来 → 立刻让位

它发的消息 source.kind 是 `dsh-unstuck`，跟桌面端按钮的 `continue` 区

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin: session cost in CNY and the live peak/off-peak rate, beside the composer token stats.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-composer-cost

[![check](https://github.com/nickkupriyanov/dsh-plugin-composer-cost/actions/workflows/check.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/nickkupriyanov/dsh-plugin-composer-cost/actions/workflows/check.yml)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI plugin that shows **what a chat has cost** and **which DeepSeek rate window is active right now**, in the row under the composer where the token statistics already live.

![The cost pill under the composer: ~¥2.71, Off-peak](docs/pill.png)

Click the pill for the breakdown:

![The breakdown panel: model, tariff, token buckets, this chat versus subagents](docs/panel.png)

The dot is amber during peak hours and green off-peak. The panel is the same trigger-anchored dialog the neighbouring statistic pills open, and it closes on an outside click or Escape.

## What the amount covers

- **The whole chat tree.** A subagent runs as its own Session with its own durable usage, billed to the same account, so the pill sums the bound Session plus every subagent it spawned. The panel splits the two so the total stays explainable.
- **Model turns only** — the requests the provider reports usage for. See [What it cannot include](#what-it-cannot-include).

## Peak schedule

Verified against <https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing> on 2026-10-14.

| Window (UTC) | Rate |
| --- | --- |
| Monday–Friday 01:00–04:00 | peak |
| Monday–Friday 06:00–10:00 | peak |
| every other instant, including the whole weekend | off-peak, exactly 50 % of peak |

Chinese statutory public holidays are off-peak for the whole day. The official 2026 list (State Council notice 国办发明电〔2025〕7号) is built in. **The 2027 notice lands in early November 2026 — add those dates to `CN_HOLIDAYS`**, otherwise January 2027 is priced as an ordinary week.

DeepSeek ignores 调休 (make-up working days): an adjusted working Saturday is still a weekend and therefore off-peak.

## Rates

Peak rates per 1,000,000 tokens, taken verbatim from the published rate cards. DeepSeek rounds CNY and USD independently, so neither is derived from the other:

| Currency | Model | Cache hit | Cache miss | Output |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| CNY | `deepseek-flash` | 0.04 | 2 | 8 |
| CNY | `deepseek-v4-pro` | 0.30 | 9 | 27 |
| USD | `deepseek-flash` | 0.006 | 0.30 | 1.20 |
| USD | `deepseek-v4-pro` | 0.044 | 1.32 | 3.96 |

Off-peak is half of each figure. `DISPLAY_CURRENCY` selects the card shown and is `CNY` by default. DeepSeek bills no separate cache-write rate, so `cacheWriteTokens` are listed but never charged. Unknown and legacy model ids fall back to the `deepseek-flash` row.

## Install

Requires a DeepSeek Harness build with the Web GUI; the plugin renders into the `conversation.composer.dock` slot.

**From the Plugins page.** Sidebar → **Plugins** → **Add plugin**, paste `https://github.com/nickkupriyanov/dsh-plugin-composer-cost`, install, then reload the page.

**From the CLI** — forwards to pnpm in the profile directory:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/nickkupriyanov/dsh-plugin-composer-cost
```

**Side-loading a checkout**, without pnpm: copy the checkout into the profile and add one loader row.

```
~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/plugins/dsh-plugin-composer-cost/
```

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: composer-cost
      name: ./plugins/dsh-plugin-composer-cost/index.js
```

Then **fully restart** the harness. The host caches client bundle bytes until a restart, and the browser module id is part of that cache key; a plain page refresh will not pick up a changed bundle.

## Configuration

No runtime options — four constants at the top of `client.js` are the knobs.

| Constant | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DISPLAY_CURRENCY` | `'CNY'` | `'CNY'` or `'USD'`, selects the rate card |
| `RATE_ZONE` | `'Europe/Moscow'` | zone every displayed wall-clock time is expressed in |
| `RATE_CARDS` | see above | the published rate cards, one per currency |
| `CN_HOLIDAYS` | 2026 list | Chinese statutory holidays as `YYYY-MM-DD` |

## Accuracy

The durable `tokenUsage` projection carries whole-session totals with no per-request timestamps, so the cost is priced at the tariff in force at render time. A session that spans a peak boundary lands between the peak and off-peak figure; a session that never crosses one is exact.

Amounts print two decimals, and each part is rounded before summing so **This chat + Subagents** always equals the printed total. An amount that would round to zero prints `<¥0.01` rather than claiming to be free.

### What it cannot include

- **Session titles and web search.** Both are billed provider calls that the session log records as `session/title-llm-request` and `web/deepseek-search-llm-request` — requests only, with no usage attached, so no local computation can price them.
- **Other clients on the same account.** `platform.deepseek.com/usage` is account-wide; this pill is per chat.

### Comparing with the billing console

Their totals differ for two structural reasons.

1. **Scope.** A pill is the lifetime of one chat tree, not a day. A chat that ran across midnight keeps its whole total.
2. **The console day is Beijing time.** Its day starts at 00:00 Beijing = 16:00 UTC of the previous day, so a session that ran at 00:01 Beijing belongs to "today" while a UTC-day total excludes it.

Measured on 2026-10-14 at 12:34 UTC by folding every session log on one machine and pricing at the off-peak CNY card:

| Window | Total |
| --- | ---: |
| UTC day, 2026-10-14 00:00Z to now | CNY 2.0752 |
| Beijing day, 2026-10-13 16:00Z to now | CNY 2.2944 |
| console reported | CNY 2.3300 |

The Beijing-day window lands within 1.5 % of the console; the residual is the helper calls above.

## Files

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | Bundle manifest: `dsh.bundle.patch`, the `dsh.client` web half, display metadata |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the `composer-cost` loader row |
| `index.js` | Host half — intentionally empty |
| `client.js` | The pill, its panel, styles, dictionaries, and slot registration |
| `locale/*.json` | Plugin Manager card title and description |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin Manager artwork |

No Harness Client package is imported: anchoring, outside-pointer dismissal, Escape handling and the coin glyph are implemented in `client.js` against `--dsw-*` design tokens only.

## Development

No build step and no dependencies: `client.js` is the browser artifact in the
loader lazy-factory form, checked in as source. Because nothing type-checks it
before the Harness materializes it, `scripts/check.cjs` enforces the package
contract instead - every exported entry point exists, the bundle patch names
this package, the factory id equals the package name, and no Harness Client
package is imported.

```sh
npm run check
```

CI runs the same checks on Node 20 and 22 for every push and pull request.

## Changelog

Release notes live in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Marginal notes for DSH. Mark assistant replies in the conversation and keep them as notes.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-marginalia

在 DeepSeek Harness 的对话里，把值得留下的句子标出来，收成笔记，并就其中一句接着问。助手的回复和自己发出的内容都可以。问句开在旁边的侧栏里，主对话留在原来的页面。

Mark a sentence in a DeepSeek Harness conversation, keep it as a note, and ask about that sentence alone. This works on assistant replies and on messages you sent. The question opens in the side column. The main conversation stays where it is.

[中文说明](#中文) · [English](#english)

---

## 中文

这是 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的一个插件。对话页上，「学习」和「对话」并列。空白的新对话不显示这排标签。

你留在对话里，选中助手写给你的一段话，或自己发出的一段话。光标右上方会出现一张白卡片，右键打开的是同一张。卡片上有五件事：

| 按钮 | 做什么 |
|---|---|
| 复制 | 把选中的这段放进剪贴板。 |
| 标记 / 取消标记 | 给这段加上或去掉颜色。点标记后，上方浮出红、蓝、黄；加号打开调色板。自己选的颜色会留下，一共最多 5 种。颜色只留在原文上，不会自动进笔记。 |
| 划线 / 取消划线 | 给这段加金色下划线，或把下划线去掉。下划线只留在原文上，不会自动进笔记。 |
| 加入笔记 / 移出笔记 | 把选中的整段收进「学习」。原文出现浅灰色虚线下划线。再选中同一段，可以移出。 |
| 提问 / 追问 | 就这段发问。已经问过的，接着问同一条。 |

思考过程不会出现这张卡片。

### 笔记

「加入笔记」收进的整段，以及提问和追问，都进「学习」页。标记和划线不会自动出现在这里。每一条都能改摘录、问题和批注，也能删除。摘录会记下原文里的加粗、斜体和代码。上面是预览，落在这段里的标记颜色和金色划线也会画在预览上，下面一格是 Markdown，改完会保存。复制选区和「复制笔记」带上的也是这份 Markdown。同一大段里如果拆成了好几张，改摘录就能收成你想留的那一张，多余的删掉。

「笔记 · 数量」旁边可以按类别筛选，类别可以自己添加。每条笔记选一个类别，没选的是未分类。勾选之后可以全选当前筛出来的笔记，一起改类别或删除。复制笔记时带上类别，并且只复制当前筛出来的这些。

笔记写在本机的 `~/.dsh/study-notes/`（Windows 上是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\study-notes\`），按工作区分开，里面是 `index.json` 和对应的 Markdown。不写进你正在打开的项目仓库。

再选中同一段，按钮变成「取消标记」「取消划线」或「移出笔记」。取消标记和取消划线只去掉原文上的颜色或金色下划线。移出笔记会从「学习」里拿走整段，并去掉虚线下划线。选区跟已有标注重叠，或去掉空白后是同一句，也算这一条。别处还有一句完全相同的文字时，会一起取消。

### 就一句话提问

选「提问」，写上例如「这段是什么」，也可以先选模型。

这句话不会被划线。问题和摘录记在「学习」里。这句话还在对话里时，句末出现一个小引用符号：

- 合上时，只有这个符号。
- 点开后，是贴在这句话旁边的便利贴，里面是你的问题和这条进程最新的一条回复。
- 回复还没写完时，便利贴上是「正在回答…」。
- 按 Esc，或点「合上」，便利贴收起。

提问不会把主对话换成另一页。回答写在侧栏里，不写到主对话下面。旁边的「任务管理」仍能看见这条进程。

### 一条进程可以一直问下去

一条笔记对应一条进程。不同的句子是并排的几条，互不套娃。

这条进程开在右侧栏，输入方式和主对话一样，新的一轮往下接在同一页。下面三种问法都进这一条，不会再套出「主进程 → 子进程 → 子进程」：

- 在侧栏里直接打字。
- 在主对话里对同一句再点「追问」。
- 在已经打开的这条进程里再选一段追问。

它记得自己前面的回答。更早那种问完即止、不能接着写的进程，需要回到主对话重新提问。

### 模型

三处可以选模型：选中文字后浮出的提问卡、「学习」页上的提问或追问、以及已经打开的子进程输入框上方。

- 「跟随当前对话」：新开的这条用你当前对话的模型。
- 「沿用当前模型」：这次追问不换。
- 点名一个模型：新进程从这一轮就用它；已经打开的进程，从下一条回复起用它。正在写的那一条不会中途换掉。

列表里先是 DeepSeek V4 Pro 和 DeepSeek Flash，然后是桌面配置 `profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` 里写明的模型。没有的模型会提示「没有这个模型」。子进程页面上，软件自带的模型菜单不会出现，所以换模型用的是输入框上方这一处。

### 安装

从 npm 安装当前发布的版本。profile 名一般是 `desktop`。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-marginalia
```

要固定版本，把包名写成 `dsh-marginalia@0.1.3`。装好或更新后，把 DeepSeek Harness 完全退出，包括托盘图标，再打开。只关窗口不够。

也可以从本机目录安装。把路径换成这套插件所在的目录：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./path/to/dsh-marginalia
```

查看 npm 上的版本：

```bash
npm view dsh-marginalia version
```

包页面是 https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-marginalia 。

要求 Node.js 20 或更高，DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3`。这份 0.1.3 是按桌面版 `0.2.1-rc.2` 写的。

不要把本插件再写进 profile 自己的 `cordis.patch.yml`。命令行看到 `package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 后，会自己把 `cordis.patch.yml` 接上。写两遍会挂两次。

### 边界

- 一次标注最多 4000 字。一条对话最多 400 条。一条批注、一个问题最多 2000 字。
- 便利贴里的回复最多显示 20000 字。
- 还没有自动整理，也没有导出 PDF。
- 进程没在运行时，换模型会提示「这条进程没有在运行，换不了模型。」

本地检查：

```bash
node --test lib/model.test.js lib/quote.test.js
```

### 发布到 npm

同一版本只能发布一次。先改版本号，再发布。`--no-git-tag-version` 只改 `package.json`，不会自己做 Git 提交，因此不需要先设置 Git 作者。

```bash
npm login
npm whoami
npm version patch --no-git-tag-version
npm publish --access public
```

`npm login` 在 npm 11 里会打开网页确认。成功时 `npm whoami` 显示用户名，`npm publish` 的最后一行是 `+ dsh-marginalia@x.y.z`。

如果发布返回 403，并写着需要 two-factor authentication 或 granular access token with bypass 2fa，网页登录留下的令牌不能用来发版。到 https://www.npmjs.com/settings/~/tokens 新建 Granular Access Token，权限选 Read and write，范围选 All packages，并勾选 Bypass two-factor authentication。然后在自己的终端执行 `npm config set //registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken`，后面接那枚新令牌，再重新 `npm publish --access public`。不要把令牌或验证码写进仓库、对话或截图。发完可以删掉这枚令牌。

## English

dsh-marginalia is a desktop plugin for DeepSeek Harness. On the conversation page, a tab named 学习 sits beside 对话. A blank new chat hides that tab row.

Stay in the conversation and select part of an assistant reply, or part of a message you sent. A white card appears at the upper right of the caret. A right-click opens the same card.

| Button | What it does |
|---|---|
| 复制 | Copy the selection. |
| 标记 / 取消标记 | Color the span, or clear that mark. After 标记, a row floats above with red, blue, and yellow. + opens a palette. Chosen colors are kept, and there can be at most five. The color stays on the message and does not become a note by itself. |
| 划线 / 取消划线 | Underline the span in gold, or clear that underline. The underline stays on the message and does not become a note by itself. |
| 加入笔记 / 移出笔记 | Add the whole selection to 学习. The message gets a light gray dashed underline. Select that same passage again to remove the note. |
| 提问 / 追问 | Ask about this span. If you already asked, continue that same side conversation. |

The reasoning trace does not open this card.

### Notes

Passages added with 加入笔记, plus questions and follow-ups, are listed on the 学习 page. A color mark or a gold underline does not appear there on its own. Each row can edit the excerpt, the question, and the comment, and each row can be deleted. The excerpt keeps bold, italics, and code from the original message. The card shows a preview, including mark colors and gold underlines that fall inside that passage, and the box under it is the Markdown you can change and save. Copying a selection, and 复制笔记, both carry that Markdown. If one passage was split into several notes, edit the excerpt so the one you want covers it, then delete the extras.

Beside the note count, the list can be filtered by category, and categories can be added freely. Each note can be given one; a note without one stays uncategorized. Checked notes can be selected together, then assigned a category or deleted. 复制笔记 includes the category and copies only the notes the filter is showing.

Notes are stored on this machine under `~/.dsh/study-notes/` (`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\study-notes\` on Windows), grouped by workspace, as `index.json` plus a Markdown file. They are not written into the project you have open.

Select the same span again and the button becomes 取消标记, 取消划线, or 移出笔记. Clearing a color or a gold underline leaves the notes list unchanged. 移出笔记 removes that passage from 学习 and clears the dashed underline. An overlapping selection, or the same words with different line breaks, counts as that mark. The same quote elsewhere is removed with it.

### Ask about one sentence

Choose 提问 and type something like “这段是什么”. You can pick a model first.

The sentence is not underlined. The question and the excerpt are saved on the 学习 page. While that sentence is still in the conversation, a small citation mark sits at the end:

- Collapsed, only that mark is visible.
- Expanded, a sticky note beside the sentence shows your question and the latest reply.
- Until the reply is finished, the note says 正在回答….
- Esc, or 合上, closes it.

The question does not replace the main conversation. The reply is written in the side column, not under the main conversation. The side task list still shows this child.

### One child keeps going

One note is one side conversation. Different sentences are parallel conversations. They do not nest inside each other.

The child opens in the right column. You type there the same way as in the main conversation, and the next turn extends downward on that page. These three actions all continue that same child:

- Type in the side column.
- Choose 追问 on the same sentence in the main conversation.
- Select text inside the open child and ask again.

The child keeps its own earlier answers. An older one-shot child cannot be continued. Ask again from the main conversation.

### Models

You can choose a model in three places: the card that appears after a selection, the ask form on the 学习 page, and the control labeled 模型 above the input of an open child.

- 跟随当前对话 starts the new child with the model of the conversation you asked from.
- 沿用当前模型 leaves the current model in place for this follow-up.
- A named model is used from the first turn of a new child, or from the next reply of a child that is already open. A reply that is already being written is left as it is.

The list starts with DeepSeek V4 Pro and DeepSeek Flash, then the models declared in `profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`. An unknown model is

plugins.description: Telegram user-account (MTProto) plugin for DeepSeek Harness: channels, messages, in-chat search, comments, links, whitelisted sending, a DSH bot chat and a Telegram-to-DSH bridge, managed from a mobile-friendly Settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-telegram — Telegram 用户号（MTProto）插件

用**你自己的 Telegram 账号**（userbot / MTProto，不是 Bot API）给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) 提供频道与消息能力。
Bot API 看不到你账号里的频道；这个插件直接以你的会话登录，能看到的和你手机/桌面端完全一致。

同一个插件里还带一个**机器人身份**：在专用群里以「DSH」的名字和头像说话，并把群里的话桥接进 DSH 会话。

## 能力

- **13 个工具**：会话列表、消息（分页 / 单条 / 频道内全文搜索 / 媒体过滤）、全账号服务端搜索、
  内联按钮读写与点击、评论区、链接与网页正文、白名单发送、加入退出、转发、收件箱、DSH 私聊。
- **设置页**（DSH 设置 → Telegram）：登录、代理、白名单、DSH 群与机器人、桥接开关；宽度 < 640px 自动单列，
  控件 42px、输入框 16px（不触发 iOS 缩放）、支持 `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`，手机上直接可用。
- **授权类操作只由人来做**：`tg_login` 只有 `status`，`tg_whitelist` 只有 `list`。登录、退出、改代理、增删白名单
  都不是工具，模型无法给自己扩权。
- **出口归一化**：工具返回值统一走 `toLossless`（BigInt、`undefined`、TL 记录都不会让调用炸掉），再渲染成紧凑文本。
- **省 token 的结果渲染**：一条消息一行、标题只出现一次、按条数分配正文预算，见下文「结果形状」与「省 token」。

## 安装

仓库：<https://github.com/EndPB/dsh-telegram>

### 在 DSH Desktop 里（推荐）

1. DSH 设置 → **插件** → **添加插件**，粘贴 `https://github.com/EndPB/dsh-telegram`，点安装。
2. 第一次会以 `build-blocked` 结束（原因见下节），点 **「允许这些脚本并重试」** 即可，不用敲命令。
3. 重启 DSH 一次：新安装且带 `dsh.client` 的包只在启动时登记客户端模块，设置页才会出现。

### 用 pnpm（DSH 的 profile 目录）

1. 在 DSH 桌面版的 profile 目录（默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop`）：

   ```powershell
   cd $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop
   pnpm add "@local/dsh-telegram@github:EndPB/dsh-telegram"
   ```

2. 在同一个 profile 的 `package.json` 里，把 `@local/dsh-telegram` 加进 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组。
3. 重启 DSH 一次。

升级：重复安装步骤拉默认分支；要钉版本就写 `…@github:EndPB/dsh-telegram#<tag 或 commit>`。
仓库里已经提交了 `lib/` 与 `client.js`（没有 `prepare` 构建步），所以 `pnpm` 直接从 git 装出来的包即可运行。

### 安装时 `build-blocked` / `pnpm` 失败怎么办

pnpm 11 默认拦下依赖的安装脚本，而本插件依赖的 GramJS（`telegram`）树里有三个包带 `install` / `postinstall`：
`bufferutil`、`utf-8-validate`（`websocket` 的可选原生加速，有预编译二进制）和 `es5-ext`（只打一行自检）。
DSH 在 profile 里启用了 `strictDepBuilds`，所以第一次安装会以 `build-blocked` 结束，并在结果里给出 `pendingBuilds`。
包其实已经抓取成功，只是脚本没有权限运行。

任选一种放行后重试：

- DSH 插件页：安装失败时点 **「允许这些脚本并重试」**；
- 工具调用：`plugin_manager action=install_bundle` 带上
  `approvedBuilds: ["bufferutil", "es5-ext", "utf-8-validate"]`（需要使用者先同意，授权按包名保存在该 profile）；
- 手工：在 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里加上

  ```yaml
  allowBuilds:
    bufferutil: true
    es5-ext: true
    utf-8-validate: true
  ```

这三条脚本只决定 WebSocket 用不用原生加速，不跑也能正常收发消息。

## 第一次使用

1. 到 <https://my.telegram.org/apps> 创建应用，拿到 `api_id` / `api_hash`（验证码发到你**已登录**的 Telegram 客户端，不发短信）。
2. DSH 设置 → **Telegram**：填 api_id / api_hash / 手机号（国际格式 `+86…`）→「发送验证码」→ 填验证码 →（需要时）两步验证密码。
3. 登录后把允许发消息的会话加进白名单：`@频道`、t.me 链接、数字 id 或精确标题，逐个可移除。

登录成功得到 StringSession（MTProto auth key），保存在运行态 `settings.json`（0600），重启后自动重连。
运行态文件：`%DSH_HOME%\dsh-telegram\settings.json`（`%DSH_HOME%` 默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`）。

## 设置页

DSH 设置 → **Telegram**（与「语音」并列）。页面分六块：

| 区块 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 账号 | 是否已登录、姓名/@username/id、网络路径、未读收件箱条数、settings.json 路径、刷新 |
| 登录 | 首次：api_id / api_hash / 手机号 → 发送验证码 → 验证码 →（需要时）两步验证密码；已登录：退出 |
| 代理 | 自动（跟随系统代理）/ 直连 / 自定义 `host:port`（SOCKS5），应用后立即重连 |
| 白名单 | 列出已允许的会话，逐个「移除」；输入 `@频道`、t.me 链接、数字 id 或精确标题后「添加」 |
| DSH 私聊 | 群是否存在、peer id；创建/重新检查；机器人状态（名字、@username、id）、创建/重新检查 |
| 桥接 | 总开关；目标会话下拉（默认「最近活跃的会话」，可绑定到具体会话） |

页面用宿主的主题 token（`--dsw-alias-*`）着色，不依赖任何 Client 包，也不写 `document.body`。
改动立即写进 `settings.json`，Host 侧按 mtime 热重载，不需要重启。

## 工具一览

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `tg_login` | 只读：`status`（登录状态、代理、身份、白名单、DSH 群、未读数） |
| `tg_dialogs` | 列出会话：频道、群、私聊；按类型、标题、@username、peer id 过滤 |
| `tg_messages` | 读消息：分页（before/after）、单条（id）、频道内全文搜索（search）、媒体过滤（filter） |
| `tg_search` | 高级搜索：`global` 全账号服务端搜索（日期区间、媒体类型、只看频道）、`chat` 频道内搜索、`channels` 找公开频道 |
| `tg_buttons` | 读/按消息上的按钮：`list` 列出内联键盘与回复键盘（带 1-based 序号），`press` 按序号或文字点击（`GetBotCallbackAnswer`，`DATA_INVALID` 时退化为发送按钮文字），返回机器人回调应答、被编辑的消息和/或新消息 |
| `tg_comments` | 打开频道帖子的评论区（GetDiscussionMessage + GetReplies），白名单内可 `reply` 回复 |
| `tg_links` | 抓取消息里的链接；把 `t.me` 深链解析成具体消息；`fetch=true` 抓网页正文 |
| `tg_send` | 在白名单频道发消息（白名单外一律拒绝） |
| `tg_join` | 加入/退出频道、群（@username、t.me、`t.me/+邀请码`、标题片段） |
| `tg_whitelist` | 只读：`list`；增删只能由人在设置页操作 |
| `tg_forward` | 转发频道消息到指定会话，默认转发到 DSH 专用私聊 |
| `tg_dsh` | DSH 私聊：`ensure` 创建并把机器人拉进去 / `send` 以机器人身份发言 / `read` 读取（带 fromDsh 标记） |
| `tg_inbox` | 收件箱：DSH 私聊里的留言、白名单频道的回复、评论区新评论（MTProto updates 实时收集） |

### 结果形状

工具结果不是 JSON，而是给人读的紧凑文本：

- 一条消息一行：`#id 时间 发送者[标记] 正文`，会话标题只出现一次；`…+N` 表示省略了 N 个字。
- 标记：`[dsh]` 机器人发出、`[media]`、`[pin]`、`[edit]`、`[fwd:x]`、`[r:id]` 回复、`[th:id]` 讨论串、`[c:N]` 评论数。
- 需要全文时调 `tg_messages id=…`（单条返回完整正文，最多 4000 字）；分页页眉会直接给出下一页的 `before`。

## 网络与代理

- 直连不通时，插件**自动复用系统代理**：读 Windows `HKCU\…\Internet Settings` 的 `ProxyServer`，
  先做一次真实 SOCKS5 握手探测，通了才用；没代理或探测失败就退回直连。
- 设置页「代理」可在 自动 / 直连 / 自定义 之间切换，切换后立即断开重连。
- Bot API（`api.telegram.org`）先直连，失败再用同一个代理做 CONNECT 重试；成功的那条路径会被记住，
  不会每条消息都等一次超时。
- 也认环境变量 `TG_PROXY` / `ALL_PROXY` / `HTTPS_PROXY`。

## 白名单与安全

- 只有白名单里的会话能通过 `tg_send` / `tg_comments.reply` 发消息；白名单为空时**所有发送都被拒绝**。
- 白名单里的会话会自动加入 `watch`，收到的新消息进 `tg_inbox`。
- 白名单、登录、代理都是**人独有的权力**：工具层没有对应动作，模型无法给自己加频道或改网络。
- `settings.json` 里有 auth key 和机器人 token（等同密码），文件权限 0600，不要外传；退出登录会清掉会话。
- 模型侧还有一条硬规矩写进系统提示：不转发用户没让它发的内容，不在会话之间搬运内容，不吐 api_hash / session / bot token。

## DSH 私聊、机器人与桥接

- **群**：一个只有你 + 机器人的私有 megagroup（设置页「DSH 私聊」可创建/重新检查，peer id 存在 `settings.json`）。
- **机器人**：你自己的账号通过 @BotFather 创建（`/newbot` → `/setname` → `/setuserpic`），token 只存在本机；
  `scripts/setup-bot.mjs`、`scripts/attach-bot.mjs`、`scripts/bot-setname.mjs`、`scripts/bot-setpic.mjs` 是等价的命令行做法。
- **DSH 说话**：`tg_dsh action=send` → Bot API `sendMessage`，群里显示机器人的名字和头像；
  机器人发送失败时退回你的账号发送，并在返回值里注明 `via: "account"`。
- **回声不脏收件箱**：发送返回的 `message_id` 直接写进 `outbox`，`readDsh` 也会按 sender id 标记 `fromDsh`。
- **桥接**：你在群里发消息 → 插件 1.5s 去抖后把它作为一条提示 `sessionController.prompt(...)` 送进目标会话
  （设置页可绑定，默认最近活跃会话）→ 模型看到提示后用 `tg_dsh action=send` 回复。
  每次桥接的结果（时间、成功/失败、会话 id、条数）记在 `settings.bridge.last`，设置页可据此排查。
- 桥接可随时在设置页关掉；关掉后消息只进收件箱，等模型主动调用 `tg_inbox`。

## 搜索群（发关键词的机器人）

很多「资源搜索」群不是靠 Telegram 搜索：你把关键词当普通消息发出去，机器人**删掉你的消息**，
再回一条带内联按钮的结果（`关键词：…`、`🔍共 N 条结果，当前第 X 页，共 Y 页`、`群组/频道/视频/更多筛选`、`➡️下一页`）。

1. `tg_send` 把关键词发进群（需要白名单，否则拒绝）。
2. 等 1–3 秒，`tg_messages` 看最新一条机器人结果，或直接 `tg_buttons action=list chat=…`（省略 msgId = 取最近一条带按钮的消息）。
3. `tg_buttons action=press` 点 `➡️下一页` / `视频` / `群组` / `频道` / `更多筛选`：
   机器人**原地编辑同一条消息**，所以 `updated` 里就是新一页的内容，`msgId` 不变。
4. 别人可能同时在搜：他们的结果会成为**新消息**，不影响你这条；所以一定要带 `msgId`（或按 label）操作。

键盘是**动态的**（点「视频」后第 4 个按钮会从「更多筛选」变成「收起筛选」），
按序号容易点错，优先用 `label`；返回值里的 `pressed.text` 才是真正点到的按钮。

## 省 token

这个插件每次对话要付两笔账：**常驻开销**（13 个工具的定义 + 系统提示段落，每次请求都发）和
**单次调用开销**（工具结果的文本）。两笔都压过：

1. **紧凑结果渲染**（`lib/render.js`，工具返回值本身不变）：一条消息一行，会话标题只出现一次；
   不再为每条消息重复 `chatId`/`chat`、派生字段（links / hashtags / mentions）和 `views`/`forwards`。
2. **按长度分配正文预算**：3 条消息时每条最多 600 字（短页直接给全文，不用再查一次），
   20 条 300 字，50 条 120 字；截断处标 `…+N`，看全文用 `tg_messages id=…`。
3. **工具定义瘦身**：说明改成一句话，参数里重复的说明删掉，`CHAT_DESCRIPTION` 缩短；
   系统提示只留状态与约定（工具用途不再复述）。
4. **默认页大小下调**：会话 30、消息 20、搜索 20、搜频道 15、评论 30、收件箱 30、DSH 私聊 20。

实测（估算 token：1 个中文字/emoji ≈ 1，3.5 个 ASCII ≈ 1）：

| 指标 | 0.2 | 0.3 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 13 个工具定义 | 3759 tok | **2908 tok** |
| 系统提示段落 | 599 tok | **357 tok** |
| **每次请求常驻** | **4341 tok** | **3254 tok**（-25%） |
| 一次会话列表（3 条） | 406 tok | **196 tok**（-52%） |
| 一次消息列表（3 条） | 563 tok | **353 tok**（-37%） |

复现：`node scripts/measure-tokens.mjs .`（在装有依赖的目录里跑；样本在 `scripts/fixtures/`，
结构与真实返回一致，id 与文本已脱敏）。

## 架构

```
index.js            apply()：13 个工具、system prompt 段、设置页 RPC、Telegram→DSH 桥接、生命周期
client.js           设置页（settings.section `telegram`，React + 主题 token + 响应式 CSS）
lib/session.js      TelegramSession：登录、客户端复用、peer 解析、收发、评论、inbox、机器人、群
lib/botapi.js       Bot API：直连 + HTTP 代理 CONNECT + 长消息切分
lib/store.js        settings.json 持久化（原子写、0600、按 mtime 热重载）
lib/format.js       TL 对象 → 模型友好的紧凑记录（链接、hashtag、媒体类型、回复关系）
lib/proxy.js        系统代理探测（SOCKS5 握手）+ 手动代理
lib/tools.js        工具定义（JSON Schema + 执行，出口统一 toLossless 归一化 BigInt/undefined）
lib/render.js       工具结果的紧凑文本渲染（token 预算、…+N、回查提示）
scripts/            一次性运维脚本（建机器人、改名、换头像、拉群）+ token 度量
```

设置页与 Host 之间走 `connection.rpc` 的 `/dsh-telegram` 通道：状态、登录、代理、白名单、机器人、会话列表、桥接设置。
通道只有在同时注入 `connection` 与 `webServer` 的上下文里注册，才会挂到 webServer 上。

对话列表缓存 60s；inbox 是内存 + settings 的环形缓冲（400 条），写入防抖 1.2s；桥接对多条消息做 1.5s 合并。

## 已知限制

- 只处理文本与媒体标记，不下载文件/图片字节。
- 客户端（设置页）的首次加载需要 DSH 重启一次：客户端模块表在启动时扫描，之前没有 `dsh.cl

plugins.description: Zero-token scheduled script runner for DeepSeek Harness (dsh-plugin): cron in the Host, no model calls, wake-on-change
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-noagent-schedule

**Run shell scripts on a schedule inside DeepSeek Harness — with no model call and no token cost.**

Every scheduling plugin in the DSH ecosystem delivers a message to a session or starts a new one,
so a cron tick always means a model wake-up. This plugin takes the other path: the Host runs the
command itself, the way `systemd` or `launchd` would. The model is only involved when you actually
want it to be — see [wake on change](#wake-on-change).

[简体中文](README.zh.md)

## What it gives you

| | |
|---|---|
| **Zero token** | A tick that runs a script costs nothing. The plugin never touches the LLM services. |
| **Cron or interval** | Five-field Vixie cron (`*/15 9-17 * * 1-5`, `sun..sat`, `jan..dec`) or `everySeconds`. |
| **Explicit time zones** | IANA zones per job, so the schedule means what it says regardless of where the Host runs. |
| **Logs you can read** | One file per run with argv, exit code, stdout and stderr; a `runs.jsonl` ledger beside it. |
| **Overlap protection** | A job whose previous run is still going is skipped, not stacked. |
| **Timeout** | Oversized jobs are terminated at `timeoutSeconds`. |
| **Qinglong-style task page** (open it from the sidebar; not duplicated in Settings) | Overview cards, search and status filter, one row per job with a status dot, a human-readable schedule ("daily 18:30" instead of `30 18 * * *`), last and next run, a strip of the last 8 results, and a log drawer. |
| **Edit from the page** | Enable or disable a job, change its cron or interval, timeout, name or command, and delete it. Every write is validated, backed up, and re-parsed before it lands, so `jobs.json` can never be left unloadable. |
| **Agent tools** | `noagent_status`, `noagent_run`, `noagent_log`, `noagent_update` — the same operations the UI uses. |
| **Wake on change** | Turn a polling script into an event source: the model is woken only when its output changes. |

## Install

### From the plugin market (Discover)

Open **Plugins > Discover > Manage index sources** and add:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/monkey-sking/dsh-noagent-schedule/main/index.json
```

The bundle then appears in the Discover list with its description and icon, and installs like any other entry. (The Discover tab needs the experimental plugin-market bundle enabled.)

### From a checkout

```
git clone https://github.com/monkey-sking/dsh-noagent-schedule.git
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "<cloned directory>" })
```

Or point `target` at a checkout of this repository.

Nothing is scheduled until you write a job file.

## Where things live

| | Default | Configure |
|---|---|---|
| Job list | `~/.dsh/noagent/jobs.json` | `jobsFile` |
| State and logs | `~/.dsh/noagent/state/` | `stateDir` |

The job file is re-read every 10 seconds, so adding, editing or disabling a job needs no restart.

```
state/
├── state.json              # per job: last start, exit code, duration, fingerprint
├── runs.jsonl              # one line per run
└── runs/<job-id>/<ts>.log  # full stdout/stderr of that run
```

## Jobs

```json
{
  "jobs": [
    {
      "id": "nightly-backup",
      "name": "Nightly backup",
      "enabled": true,
      "cron": "0 3 * * *",
      "timeZone": "Asia/Shanghai",
      "cwd": "/srv/app",
      "command": "bash scripts/backup.sh",
      "timeoutSeconds": 600
    }
  ]
}
```

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Unique, also the log directory name. Required. |
| `cron` | Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. Supports `*/n`, `a-b`, `a-b/n`, lists, `sun..sat`, `jan..dec`. |
| `everySeconds` | Fixed interval, minimum 30. Use instead of `cron`. |
| `timeZone` | IANA zone. Defaults to the plugin's `defaultTimeZone`. |
| `cwd` | Working directory. Defaults to the user's home. |
| `command` | Run through `/bin/bash -lc`. Alternatively use `argv` for an exact process. |
| `argv` | Array form; no shell involved. |
| `env` | Extra environment variables, merged over the inherited environment. |
| `timeoutSeconds` | Terminate after this long. Default 300. |
| `enabled` | `false` keeps the job in the file but does not schedule it. |
| `wakeOnChange` | See below. |

### Why `bash -lc`

A GUI-launched Host inherits a minimal `PATH` — often just `/usr/bin:/bin`. A login shell picks up
the user's profile, so `git`, `node`, `python3` and friends resolve the way they do in a terminal.
Homebrew's standard prefixes are prepended as a fallback.

If you would rather not depend on shell startup files, use `argv` with absolute paths.

## Wake on change

A polling script usually answers one question: *did anything change?* Running it on a timer is
free; waking a model to ask the same question every few minutes is not.

`wakeOnChange` separates the two:

```json
{
  "id": "inbox-watch",
  "everySeconds": 120,
  "command": "bash scripts/probe-inbox.sh",
  "wakeOnChange": {
    "sessionId": "session-…",
    "title": "New mail",
    "prompt": "The probe found something new:\n\n{{output}}\n\nHandle it per the usual routine; reply [SILENT] if nothing needs doing.",
    "ignoreLines": ["^ts=", "progress: \\d+%"]
  }
}
```

How it behaves:

- The probe runs every 120 seconds. **No change means no model call at all.**
- Output is normalised (lines matching `ignoreLines` are dropped), then fingerprinted.
- A changed fingerprint schedules a one-shot delivery to `sessionId` about a second later, carrying
  the probe output through `{{output}}`.
- The first run only records a baseline, so installing the plugin does not immediately wake anyone.
  Set `notifyOnFirstRun: true` to opt in.
- A non-zero exit is never treated as "something changed" — failures show up in the log and the
  status, not as false wakes.
- Every wake is a one-shot scheduled delivery, and one-shot rows stay in the Host's task table
  after delivery. The plugin deletes each wake row once it has been delivered (the previous row is
  removed before the next wake, delivered rows are swept every 30 seconds, and leftovers from an
  earlier version are cleaned on the first tick), so "automation tasks" keeps listing only the real
  recurring jobs instead of a wall of identical one-shot entries.
- Empty output means nothing to report.
- `onlyOnNew` can be narrowed with `keyPattern`: only the matched part of each line identifies an
  entry, so a conversation whose last message changes (including our own reply) is not "new"; only a
  genuinely new conversation wakes the session. Lines unmatched by the pattern fall back to the
  whole line.

Placeholders in `prompt` and `title`: `{{job}}` (name), `{{id}}` (id), `{{output}}` (truncated to
4000 characters).

The target session receives an ordinary scheduled message, so anything that already works with a
scheduled delivery works here.

## UI

- **Settings → No-Agent Schedule** — one page listing every job.
- **Sidebar → clock icon** — the same list as a panel.

Both show the schedule, time zone, command, last run (time, exit code, duration), a *Run now*
button and a *Show last log* toggle. The panel refreshes every five seconds while open.

## Agent tools

| Tool | Does |
|---|---|
| `noagent_status` | List jobs with their last run. Pass `id` for one job. |
| `noagent_run` | Run one job immediately, outside its schedule. |
| `noagent_log` | Read the tail of a job's most recent log. |

The UI and the tools call the same Host implementation.

## Limits

- **Runs only while DSH is running.** A tick missed because the Host was closed is not caught up on
  restart. For a watchdog that must survive the app being closed, use `launchd`, `systemd` or
  `cron` instead — that is what they are for.
- **Not a sandbox.** Jobs run with the Host's own permissions. Treat the job file as executable
  configuration.
- **macOS may still refuse access.** A Host process inherits the app's TCC grants; a job touching a
  protected location can fail where a terminal would succeed, and vice versa. Read the log rather
  than assuming.

## Related

- [agent-cron-kit](https://github.com/monkey-sking/agent-cron-kit) — the scripts this scheduler was
  built to run: a stdout→Feishu/Telegram delivery bridge, git autopush and dirty-repo wa

plugins.description: An Apple Liquid Glass skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: token-level re-key, glass chrome, a grouped model picker and a merged usage panel.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-glass-theme

An Apple Liquid Glass skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI. Every surface in the
app is redrawn: floating glass chrome over an ambient light field, an opaque
reading surface for the transcript, and one material ladder shared by every
panel, popover and dialog.

Pure CSS plus a ~150-line client runtime. Nothing in the shipped app is patched;
the skin loads as an ordinary Harness bundle and layers its stylesheets after the
app's own.

| Light | Dark |
| --- | --- |
| ![The Liquid Glass settings page, light theme](assets/screenshots/settings-light.png) | ![The Liquid Glass settings page, dark theme](assets/screenshots/settings-dark.png) |

![The provider board at capacity, with the capacity meter full](assets/screenshots/settings-capacity.png)

## What it does

- **Re-keys the app's whole token vocabulary.** The shipped theme publishes an
  empty token set, so the palette is CSS-only. `src/css/tokens.css` re-declares
  ~250 `--dsw-*` custom properties on `body` (and `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`),
  which makes every page the skin has never heard of inherit the redesign. It
  also defines 11 properties the shipped build consumes but never defines.
- **Redraws every surface** across 15 sheets: shell, sidebar, conversation,
  composer, overlays, model, picker, stats, settings, pages, widgets, motion.
- **Replaces the composer's model picker.** `src/picker.js` mounts its own React
  card into `conversation.input.model` and hides the host trigger: grouped
  providers, a one-line description per model, the reseller price ratio as a
  badge, a live peak/off-peak chip that follows the SELECTED model's provider
  (DeepSeek: 工作日 9:00–12:00 + 14:00–18:00, ≈2×; 智谱: 工作日 14:00–18:00,
  ≈2×; providers without a schedule show no chip), and an inline effort
  segmented control beside the model list (both visible at once; picking a
  model keeps the card open). Configured providers
  narrow the default list; everything else stays behind one "所有供应商" row.
- **Merges the usage readouts.** `src/stats.js` replaces the two stat pills and
  the context ring with one control that opens a single panel: context pressure
  and its three buckets, session timings, and the token ledger. The pill sits at
  the input box's right edge and the panel hangs off that same right edge.
- **Adds its own settings page** (`settings.section`, "Liquid Glass") where the
  quick-provider list is chosen. The page has one material object — a frosted
  board lit from inside by its own light field (the settings sheet is already
  glass; a second card would be glass on glass) — with a capacity meter, glyph
  tiles, staggered entrance, and etched grain that answers
  `prefers-reduced-transparency`.
- **Answers the accessibility questions**: `prefers-reduced-transparency`,
  `prefers-contrast`, `prefers-reduced-motion`, `hover: none`, and keyboard-only
  focus rings (gated on input modality, so a pointer user never sees one).
- **Styles foreign pages.** Third-party plugins render unclassed HTML into the
  `main` slot; those controls get the app's type and control scale too, without
  reaching into markdown output.

## Install

`lib/` is committed, so a clone is ready to load — installing needs no build step.

The [releases page](https://github.com/Ayelsh/dsh-glass-theme/releases) carries
the same build as a prebuilt tarball,
[`dsh-glass-theme.tgz`](https://github.com/Ayelsh/dsh-glass-theme/releases/latest/download/dsh-glass-theme.tgz).
Its name is version-free on purpose, so that URL keeps resolving across
releases; storefronts serve it instead of a build-from-source command.

1. Copy the package into your profile's `node_modules`:

   ```sh
   cp -r . ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-glass-theme
   ```

2. Add it to that profile's bundle list in `<profile>/package.json`:

   ```json
   { "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-glass-theme"] } } }
   ```

3. Restart the Harness.

The restart is not optional: the plugin roster is composed from the profile
before the window opens, and the host half (routes, peak-rate cache, usage
ledger) is mounted at boot. Nothing in the shipped app is modified — removing
the folder and the bundle entry restores the stock interface exactly.

## Layout

```
src/css/               the 15 stylesheets, in cascade order
src/client.js          mounts the sheets, tracks modality, wires the layers
src/catalog.js         the model catalogue: providers, families, descriptions, pricing
src/picker.js          the ported model picker (React, mounted into the model slot)
src/stats.js           the merged context/usage panel
src/settings-section.js the skin's settings page
src/host/              the host half: routes, peak-rate catalogue, usage ledger
lib/client.js          build output (generated)
lib/host/              build output of src/host (generated)
vendor/                the reference package's data files and assets (MIT, see LICENSE-reference.txt)
tools/                 build + verification tooling
```

## Build and verify

```sh
node tools/verify.mjs       # every selector must resolve against the shipped build
node tools/leak.mjs         # [class*=] must not over-match sibling locals
node tools/build.mjs        # inlines src/css/*.css into lib/client.js, copies the host half
node tools/smoke.mjs        # evaluates the bundle against a stubbed DOM
node tools/assert-built.mjs # the authored rules actually survived into lib/client.js
node tools/host-check.mjs   # the host half registers its routes without throwing
```

Live probes (each needs the GUI running; they mint their own auth cookie):

```sh
node tools/two-level.mjs                # the picker's three states: unconfigured, configured, the second card
node tools/settings-page.mjs            # the skin's settings page renders, lists providers, and its switches write
node tools/pick-check.mjs               # one row checked, across providers that share a model id
node tools/effort3.mjs                  # the effort segment applies a level
node tools/picker-rows.mjs              # fail if any row lacks a description or its ratio badge is block-level
node tools/chk-chip.mjs                 # the peak/off-peak chip's state and countdown
node tools/meter.mjs --shot G:/tmp/m    # the context meter panel
node tools/stats-dom.mjs --theme light  # the two stat dialogs
node tools/rail.mjs --scan              # the turn rail's hover previews
```

`verify.mjs` is the important one. A skin is nothing but selectors, so a wrong
hash prefix or a renamed local is a silently dead rule — no error, no warning,
just a surface that keeps its old look. The tool resolves every token against
`research/shipped-class-map.json` (extracted from the installed app) and fails
the build on a miss.

### The inventories `verify.mjs` resolves against

The app generates its CSS-module class names (`_local_hash`), so the only honest
way to check a selector is against the classes the *installed* build emits. Those
maps are generated, not committed — they contain the app's own stylesheet text,
which is not ours to redistribute. One step each:

```sh
node tools/extract-inventories.mjs --asar "<install>/resources/app.asar"      # shipped classes + attributes
node tools/foreign-inventory.mjs --root ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules  # installed plugin classes
```

Both write into `../research/` — one level above the package, so an installed
copy never carries them. `extract-inventories.mjs` auto-detects a local install
when `--asar` is omitted.

`assert-built.mjs` exists because the bundle escapes its own CSS: each sheet is
embedded as a JSON string, so a newline is the two characters `\` `n`. A regex
written against the source file misses in the bundle for that reason alone —
which looks exactly like a lost rule. The tool unescapes once and then asserts
both the rules that must exist and the ones that must not.

## Design rules the sheets follow

1. **A page is a reading surface; a control is glass.** The transcript column is
   opaque on purpose — text that scrolls must never sit on a moving blur. It
   picks up the room's light direction through a very low-alpha gradient instead.
2. **One ladder.** Menus are L2, sheets and

# 📦 @goodandready/dsh-opencode-provider

OpenCode Console & OpenCode Go LLM Provider for DeepSeek Harness

⭐ If you like this plugin, please star it on GitHub — it shows me that the plugin is useful to you and motivates me to keep developing it.

🐛 If you find a bug or would like to request a feature, open a GitHub issue in any language — I will review your proposal and implement useful suggestions in a future plugin version.
--- OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/) (dsh). It registers two native LLM routes: | Route | Product | Base | |---|---|---| | `opencode-direct` | OpenCode Console / Zen (pay-as-you-go) | `https://opencode.ai/inference` | | `opencode-go-direct` | OpenCode Go / Go Plus subscription | `https://opencode.ai/inference/go` | Requests resolve the key per call, so a changed credential reaches the next request without a restart. The ids use the `-direct` suffix because the built-in `llm-pi-ai` catalog already owns `opencode` and `opencode-go`. Reusing those ids makes the core registry reject the duplicate (`DUPLICATE_DIRECTORY`) and drop the built-in catalog, which hides the other providers and disables the add button. Existing sessions recorded under the old ids stay on the built-in routes; select **OpenCode (plugin)** or **OpenCode Go (plugin)** for this plugin's accounts, quotas, fallback and telemetry. ## Architecture ```mermaid graph LR subgraph DSH["DeepSeek Harness Core"] Agent["DSH Agent / Chat"] Creds["Credentials / auth.json"] end subgraph Plugin["dsh-opencode-provider"] Router{"Route Selector"} Pool["Multi-Account Pool
(Auto-Rotation & Cooldowns)"] Heatmap["Heatmap & Quota Telemetry
(5h / Week / Month)"] subgraph Transports["4 Wire Transports"] T1["OpenAI Chat"] T2["Anthropic Messages
(Thinking Signatures)"] T3["OpenAI Responses"] T4["Google GenAI
(thoughtSignature Replay)"] end end subgraph OpenCode["OpenCode Gateway"] Console["opencode-direct (Console / Zen)"] Go["opencode-go-direct (Go / Go Plus)"] end Agent --> Router Creds -.-> Pool Router -->|opencode-direct| Pool Router -->|opencode-go-direct| Pool Pool --> Heatmap Pool --> Transports T1 & T2 & T3 & T4 --> Console & Go ``` ## What works - **Four wire transports**, chosen per model: - OpenAI Chat Completions (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiMo, LongCat, Hy3, Step, …). - Anthropic Messages (Claude Haiku, MiniMax, Qwen). - OpenAI Responses (GPT, Grok, Muse). - Google Generative AI (Gemini). - **Text, reasoning, streamed tool calls, usage, finish reasons.** - **Images** through the durable attachment service, rendered natively per transport; **file attachments** are projected to DSH's deterministic handle text (the harness supplies the read-only execution path), never inline bytes. - **Tool-result images** are inlined by Anthropic, OpenAI Responses and Google; OpenAI Chat keeps the text placeholder because its tool message has no image part. - **Replay of provider metadata** where the endpoint requires it: - Anthropic thinking signatures. - Gemini `thoughtSignature` on historical function calls. - **Multi-account rotation** before a stream starts: 401/403/429 and quota/usage-limit bodies (400/402/403/429). An invalid key cools down for 24h, a quota rejection for 10 minutes or `Retry-After`, a rate limit for 60s or `Retry-After`. A request already streaming is never replayed on another account; the next request uses the next usable key. - **Per-account quotas**: each account row shows its own 5-hour / weekly / monthly usage, the active account drives the sidebar and quota panel, and the panel lists every account side by side. - **Per-account runway**: estimates time to exhaustion from the average burn rate of each window and marks the first window projected to run out before its reset; approximate because the API exposes only the current percentage and reset time. - **Model → account rules**: first matching glob pins a preferred account for that model; the other accounts remain fallbacks if it fails or is cooling. - **Request heatmap** in the quota panel: a Monday-first weekday × hour grid in local time, plus a 24-hour aggregate strip underneath. Selectors switch between all requests, any single model, and any single account. A per-account table shows requests, errors and average latency/TTFT. The adapter appends `{at, provider, model, purpose?, account, reason, ok, latencyMs, ttftMs?, error?}` to `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-opencode/requests.jsonl`; no prompt, response or key is stored. Auxiliary `session-title`/`compaction` calls are excluded from the heatmap and exact duplicate records collapse. The log compacts at 2 MB to the newest 5000 lines. Collection starts with this build — the projection cache only has `lastPromptAt`, not per-request timestamps. - **Stable `x-opencode-session`** derived from the durable session id, so retries and every turn of a conversation reuse the same routing key. - **Live catalog** from `/v1/models` with a generated `models.dev` fallback. - **Per-model subscription limits** from the OpenCode Go pricing table: monthly dollar allowance plus estimated requests for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, for both Go and Go Plus. Shown in the model picker and the settings page; estimates only — the gateway remains the authority. - **`/opencode` command** for status, usage, accounts, models, rules, and `test [model]`. - **TUI settings section** for the terminal profile (`/settings → OpenCode`) with the key, endpoints, allowlist, active account, fallback model, sticky routing and timeouts. - **Quota fallback**: choose a free model in Settings → OpenCode; a Go quota rejection retries once through Console/Zen. - **Sticky account**: the last successful account is preferred for the same conversation and survives restarts via a local `sticky.json` (hashed session ids and key fingerprints only); explicit model rules and pinned accounts win. - **Routing trace** in the quota panel and per-account heatmap filter. - **One-click plugin update** in Settings → OpenCode: current/latest version, an update badge, and an **Update now** button that installs the exact npm version through the DSH CLI and asks for a restart. The host endpoint is `GET/POST /dsh-opencode/update`. - **Plan-aware Go picker**: hides models outside the Go table unless turned off; descriptions carry `Go`, `Console` or `FREE`. - **Request-wide image budget** (newest images win, oldest become an omitted placeholder) and **object-root tool-schema normalization** for MCP/third-party tools. - **Usage analytics dashboard** in the quota panel: KPI cards (requests, tokens, success, input/output, reasoning, cache, TTFT, latency, errors), a 7/30/90 selector, and Models / Days / Sessions tables. Success and error cards show `—`: the local projection does not expose failed attempts or reasoning tokens. - **Usage by model** from the local session projection cache: sessions and tokens per OpenCode model. Only numeric metadata is read; titles and message content stay local. - **Browser UI**: - **Settings → OpenCode**: key status, paste/import/clear, quota bars, accounts, model allowlist, per-model transport overrides, connection settings. -
